jobs.description: Location: Erlangen, Nürnberg, Mühlheim, Hamburg, Berlin, Lisbon, Bucharest, WarsawDepartment: SE FIN TI BCJob Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-KreisMode of Employment: Full Time or Part Time / PermanentA Snapshot of Your Day For the first 18-24 months this role has one clear focus: accompanying the carve-out of Transformation of Industry and supporting preparations for a potential future FP&A organization, hand in hand with the management team. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin.At the moment, the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is preparing to evolve towards a potential Corporate FP&A department for a future standalone company, which could bring together more than 100 finance professionals. Its possible target organization, processes and reporting architecture are still being explored, and you will contribute to this work. You report directly to the Vice President of FP&A and work alongside the management team. The role asks you to hold two hats at once: you coordinate and organize the transformation centrally, the way a program office does, and at the same time you go deep into the content - preparing and challenging the decisions yourself and then carrying them into the organization.A potential new team - the Center of Excellence - may grow out of this work: as the future organization develops, you help prepare a dedicated team that could bundle cross-cutting topics across the different FP&A teams, including standardized data and reporting, shared tools and systems, automation, process improvement and AI. Transformation of Industry from an FP&A perspective, including organizational and process changes, standalone company requirements, and Day 1 FP&A readiness* Help prepare the potential future FP&A organization together with its management team, including target structures, roles and responsibilities, job profiles, and related training and reskilling needs* Support the Vice President of FP&A in the daily business by preparing presentations, analyses, and decision-making materials for leadership and board audiences* Improve the core FP&A processes together with the management team across planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting by turning best practices into common standards* Take care of communication into the teams by explaining the why, keeping everyone informed, gathering input early, and making people part of the change journey* Help develop the concept for a potential Center of Excellence within the future FP&A organization, including scope, services, operating model, staffing, roadmap, and the opportunity to potentially grow into a team leadership roleWhat You Bring* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Business Informatics, or a related field* Longstanding experience in Controlling, FP&A, Finance Transformation, or Consulting, with the curiosity to grow into a carve-out environment* An interest in organizational design, including roles, responsibilities, and interfaces, with the confidence to contribute ideas to a management team* A solid understanding of planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting, along with strong Excel and reporting tool skills and curiosity about AI and automation* Excellent communication and change management skills, combined with the energy, structure, and drive to build something new in an evolving environment* Fluent English; additional languages are an advantageAbout the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.
